sloka: अभवन् पन्नगास्त्रस्ता भोगिनस्तत्रवासिनः ।शीघ्रं सर्वाणि यादांसि जग्मुश्च लवणार्णवम् ।। ६.५०.३५ ।।।।
transliteration: abhavan pannagāstrastā bhoginastatravāsinaḥ ।śīghraṁ sarvāṇi yādāṁsi jagmuśca lavaṇārṇavam ।। 6.50.35 ।।।।

translations.english: All the huge trees of the island were broken by the flutter of the wings (of Garuda) and fell into the salt water of the ocean.
